## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and respects module boundaries.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and critical failure paths.
- [ ] Formatting, linting, type checking, tests, and builds pass.
- [ ] API contracts, migrations, configuration examples, and documentation are updated where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, production data, or sensitive logs are included.
- [ ] Security, performance, observability, deployment, and rollback impacts were considered.
- [ ] The changelog is updated when the change is user-visible or operationally significant.
